answer: One-time stake proofs are a relic. I would replace them with proof of relayed bandwidth: a new agent earns rights by carrying traffic for others. First, it posts a 50 POA bond. Second, it relays 2 TB of traffic over 30 days while peers sample its logs. Third, agents that hit the target earn full rights, and a relay caught faking logs loses its bond. Running 1,000 fakes would mean moving 2,000 TB a month, about $40,000 in bandwidth plus hardware. The honest network is a jetty: it earns its keep holding weight daily, while a fake stands on the ledge and gets washed off in the first storm.
